residency_notes: Together's serverless endpoints do not offer region selection. Enterprise and dedicated deployments can support EU-region data residency and private networking. Passthrough models are governed by the upstream provider's data policy, so no single residency guarantee should be inferred for those routes.
prompt_training_notes: Together says data sharing for training other models is opt-in and not enabled by default. Its current privacy documentation says inputs and outputs are not stored by default, although temporary caching may be used unless configured otherwise; passthrough models follow the upstream provider's policy.
